reference_args._purpose: The EFFECTIVE training configuration of every varying-split c40 video-level run (results/in_domain_c40_vid/). V8's fixed-split sd is subtracted from that run's sd, which is only valid if the training procedure is identical. docs/v8_run.py builds its command from this file and aborts on any divergence, so the two can no longer drift apart by oversight.
reference_args._derivation: src/run_ablation.py main() passes data-root, dataset-name, epochs, image-size, batch-size, out-root and --extra; docs/overnight-plan.md supplies --extra '--group-by videos-([0-9]+)'. Everything else is the src/train.py default at commit e68b559. Verified 7bb4e11 (no_decay_param_groups) is an ancestor of e68b559, so the weight-decay fix is present in both.
reference_args._history: V8 attempt 1 passed --amp, which run_ablation never does. It confounded precision mode with split policy and cost a 155-minute run. This file exists so that cannot recur.

_v8_only._note: split_seed is the ONE intended difference from the comparison runs, which left it unset so it followed --seed.

_reproducibility_control._note: Nominally the same configuration as the varying-split seed-0 run. If it reproduces, cross-session drift is negligible and the sd comparison is sound. If not, the decomposition cannot be done across sessions and that is the reportable result.
